notes.title: Cozy Crunch Patch Notes v1.0.3
notes.content:
Cozy Crunch Patch Notes v1.0.3: 



There was an overwhelming amount of support for Cozy Crunch from the Real Civil Engineer community and I just had to give them a big thank you, so I added a separate skin in the character creator. <3



Added the special 'Paddy' skin in the character creator

Comes with unique sounds

No movement slow down on puddles

Features a custom prestigious hat

Added Italian fan translations! (A huge thank you to Gaspare Bitetto for their amazing work!)

Added celebratory confetti to the final screen

Added a Max FPS option to help with performance issues on some setups. (If you are still experiencing issues, try enabling windowed mode as that seems to help fix the only reported cases of frame rate drops)

Fixed one spot in the final area that players could not move through

Slightly moved some mushrooms so they peek out more from behind objects

Fixed an issue where the Fairy's name was not translating correctly in some dialogue windows

Fixed a bug where 'hmph' sounds would sometimes get triggered on leaves crunched by the stomp wave

Fixed a decimal rounding issue that could make it seem like you had enough for an upgrade when you didn't



Follow my developer account to be notified when any of my new games release!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.0.9
notes.content:
Demo Patch Notes v1.0.9:  

Added an area discovery tracker that appears when entering a zone, showing your discovery progress.

Added area names to the world

Added a helpful arrow to guide players towards newly unlocked areas

Added a Max FPS option in settings to help with VSync issues on some hardware

Moved UI elements further into the corners to provide a larger, clearer gameplay area

Overhauled the quest window to be smaller and more compact:

Reduced the overall width and spacing of quest elements

Adjusted text for some languages to take up less space (Sorry for the previous layout, my German friends!)

Repositioned collectibles for better visibility

Bush collectibles are now better centered within bushes

Collectibles will no longer be fully hidden behind other objects.

Added fan translations for Brazilian Portuguese (A huge thank you to AprendizZK!)

The cat will no longer move while the player is hovering over the quest UI.

Fixed an issue where the start screen could load and flash very quickly on high-performance machines.

Fixed an issue that sometimes made it difficult to select interactable objects in the starter area.

Implemented a potential fix for a tooltip resizing issue. (This was hard to test on my machine, so please let me know if it's fixed for you!)



Follow my developer account to be notified when any of my new games release!

notes.title: Cozy Crunch Patch Notes v1.0.2
notes.content:
Cozy Crunch Patch Notes v1.0.2:  

Added an area discovery tracker that appears when entering a zone, showing your discovery progress.

Added a helpful arrow to guide players towards newly unlocked areas.

Expanded customization options:

Added Manx cat variations

Added eye color options

Added many more colors for markings and eyes

Added new marking patterns

Added fan translations for Brazilian Portuguese (A huge thank you to AprendizZK!)

Fixed an issue where the start screen could load and flash very quickly on high-performance machines.

Fixed an issue that made it difficult to select interactable objects in starter area sometimes

A quick developer note: I experimented with adding a 'lizard' mode where the cat says 'leaf' after every crunch. While I love the meme, I just couldn't get it to have the same feeling/emotion, so I decided to leave it out for now. Thanks for understanding!

notes.title: Cozy Crunch Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.content:
Cozy Crunch Patch Notes v1.0.1:  

Made quest window width smaller

Changed text for some languages so it takes up less space (sorry for how it was before my German friends!)

Reduced overall width/spacing of quest elements

Cat no longer moves while hovering over quests

Moved UI elements further towards the corners of the screen to give more visible gameplay area

Moved positions of collectibles

bush collectables better centered within bushes

no longer fully behind other elements, always peaking out at least a little

Fixed tooltip resizing issue on some machines (hopefully, it was fine before on my machine so can’t exactly test it, need feedback)

Tweaked rain to have less puddles and puddles to slow you down less

Fixed typo for leaf type upgrades that should have been on leaf stages (thanks PKArtKat)

Added area names



Plans for next patch:

Fix start screen loading and flashing quickly on some powerful machines

Adding more customization options:

manx cat variations

eye color

more colors for markings + eyes

maybe more markings

Add arrow pointing to new area when unlocked

Add “lizard” mode (cat says “Leaf!” after crunching leaf”)

Add discovery tracker at bottom right of screen when entering each area so player knows if everything has been discovered in that area


Follow my developer account to be notified when any of my new games release!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #1/2/3/4:
notes.content:
These are all lumped together because the way steam doesn't let you add patch notes to demos, so had to find the workaround.

Demo Patch Notes up to v 1.0.4: 

Fixed triple stomp super smash bug and now triggers correctly when aligned with the music

Made it easier to move to the sides (smaller quests window and larger margins before moving the camera)

Added some convenience features for content creators (hidden behind some key combinations)

Fixed some crashes if steam disconnects

Fixed startup bug (so sorry for this, was working on something unrelated and somehow the entry scene got unset.  Have also fixed up my testing process to prevent this in the future!)

Added a contrast layer to make the colors pop more, will likely unlock full contrast/brightness/saturation settings down the road
